purpose: Measure runtime skill selection separately from post-load review behavior.

cases.prompt: Review the changed Python code for bugs and risks.
Review a Python change that opens files and database sessions without reliably closing them.
Review an async Python handler that calls blocking HTTP code and creates background tasks.
Review a typed Python public API that returns Any from parsed JSON.
Review a Python service change that hard-codes an API endpoint and retry timeout.
Review Python import organization and lint configuration only; do not perform a correctness review.
Review this TypeScript API route for bugs.
